M2E02-1:
SELECT u.user_name, ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) AS total_pay_amount
FROM dim_user u
JOIN fact_order o ON o.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE u.member_level = '钻石会员' AND o.pay_time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY u.user_id, u.user_name
ORDER BY total_pay_amount DESC
LIMIT 5
M2E02-2:
SELECT u.user_name, MAX(o.create_time) AS last_order_time
FROM dim_user u
JOIN fact_order o ON o.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE u.user_id IN (10105, 10068, 10118, 10035, 10021)
GROUP BY u.user_id, u.user_name
M2E02-3:
SELECT c.category_name, ROUND(SUM(x.pay_amount), 2) AS pay_amount
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id, o.pay_amount, p.category_id
    FROM fact_order o
    JOIN fact_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
    WHERE o.user_id = 10105 AND o.pay_time IS NOT NULL
) x
JOIN dim_category c ON c.category_id = x.category_id
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name
M2E02-4:
SELECT c.category_name, ROUND(SUM(x.pay_amount), 2) AS pay_amount
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id, o.pay_amount, p.category_id
    FROM fact_order o
    JOIN fact_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
    WHERE o.user_id = 10068 AND o.pay_time IS NOT NULL
) x
JOIN dim_category c ON c.category_id = x.category_id
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name
M2E06-1:
SELECT u.city, COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) AS user_cnt,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.pay_time IS NOT NULL THEN o.pay_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total_pay_amount
FROM dim_user u
LEFT JOIN fact_order o ON o.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE u.province = '广东'
GROUP BY u.city
M2E06-2:
SELECT u.user_name, ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) AS total_pay_amount
FROM dim_user u
JOIN fact_order o ON o.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE u.city = '深圳' AND o.pay_time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY u.user_id, u.user_name
ORDER BY total_pay_amount DESC
LIMIT 3
M2E06-4:
SELECT u.user_name, COUNT(*) AS browse_cnt, SUM(b.stay_seconds) AS stay_seconds
FROM fact_user_behavior b
JOIN dim_user u ON u.user_id = b.user_id
WHERE b.behavior_type = '浏览'
  AND b.user_id IN (
      SELECT o.user_id
      FROM fact_order o
      JOIN dim_user u2 ON u2.user_id = o.user_id
      WHERE u2.city = '广州' AND o.pay_time IS NOT NULL
      GROUP BY o.user_id
      ORDER BY SUM(o.pay_amount) DESC
      LIMIT 3
  )
GROUP BY u.user_id, u.user_name
M2E08-4:
SELECT s.shop_name, SUM(d.order_count) AS order_cnt
FROM dim_shop s
JOIN dws_shop_daily d ON d.shop_id = s.shop_id
WHERE s.shop_id = (SELECT shop_id FROM dim_product WHERE product_id = 30018)
GROUP BY s.shop_id, s.shop_name
M2E09-2:
SELECT u.gender, ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) AS total_pay_amount
FROM dim_user u
JOIN fact_order o ON o.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE u.age_group = '50以上' AND o.pay_time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY u.gender
M2E09-3:
SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id, p.category_id
    FROM fact_order o
    JOIN dim_user u ON u.user_id = o.user_id
    JOIN fact_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
    WHERE u.age_group = '50以上' AND u.gender = '女' AND o.pay_time IS NOT NULL
) x
JOIN dim_category c ON c.category_id = x.category_id
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name
ORDER BY order_cnt DESC
LIMIT 1
M2E09-4:
SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id, p.category_id
    FROM fact_order o
    JOIN dim_user u ON u.user_id = o.user_id
    JOIN fact_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
    WHERE u.age_group = '50以上' AND u.gender = '男' AND o.pay_time IS NOT NULL

GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name

M2E12-3:
SELECT u.user_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_order_count,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.pay_time IS NOT NULL THEN o.pay_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total_pay_amount
FROM dim_user u
JOIN fact_order o ON o.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE u.register_time >= '2024-01-01' AND u.register_time < '2025-01-01'
  AND u.register_channel = '小程序'
GROUP BY u.user_id, u.user_name
M2C02-3:
SELECT c.Country, COUNT(*) AS sold_cnt
FROM Track t
JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId
JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN Invoice i ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId
JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
WHERE t.Composer LIKE '%Chris Cornell%'
  AND al.ArtistId = 132
GROUP BY c.Country
